title: Delivery-Charge Refund for Parcels That Never Arrived: Delivery Claims Entitlement and Console Action
content:
**Entitlement.** An approved Delivery Claims Delivered Not Received or Lost in Transit Claim on an order whose effective shipping fee or surcharge was above 0.00 is owed an undelivered-parcel delivery refund where the claim was made whole by merchandise refund, booked as one shipping fee refund entry on the claim for the whole parcel, apart from its merchandise refund; a claim made whole by reshipment is owed none.

**Principle.** The delivery charge of a parcel that never reached the customer is refunded as its own compensation entry.

Booking the entry does not by itself resolve the claim.

| Approved Delivered Not Received or Lost in Transit Claim | Effective shipping fee or surcharge on the order | Undelivered-parcel delivery refund owed |
|---|---|---|
| made whole by merchandise refund | above 0.00 | yes — one shipping fee refund entry for the whole parcel, apart from the merchandise refund |
| made whole by reshipment | any | none |

Once booked, this delivery-charge refund stands on the claim as a compensation entry among the claim's compensation records, dated the day it was booked, with no order line and no units. The claim's status is not changed by the booking.

## Console action: `book_undelivered_parcel_delivery_refund_8864d5c2`

**Situation of use and capability.** Books the delivery-charge refund owed on a Delivered Not Received or Lost in Transit Claim as one compensation entry on that claim, for a parcel that never reached the customer, on an approved claim whose merchandise is refunded or reshipped. One call adds a single shipping-fee-refund compensation entry, dated today, for the whole parcel (no order line, no units), carrying the amount given. The claim's status is not changed. The booked entry appears among the claim's compensation records.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `book_undelivered_parcel_delivery_refund_8864d5c2`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` | the claim number of the Delivered Not Received or Lost in Transit Claim the refund is booked on, as returned by the delivery-claim lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the delivery-charge refund given on the claim, in USD | a positive amount rounded to 2 decimal places (to the nearest cent, on the final figure); stored exactly as passed |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `entry_id` (the reference of the new compensation entry), `claim_id` (the claim it was booked on), `compensation_type` (always `shipping_fee_refund`), `amount_usd` (the amount booked, USD with 2 decimal places) and `booked_on` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). Receiving this receipt means the refund entry now stands on the claim.
